The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 f12bd8f9ace9a350), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 60-61. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: Fix the desired output order J ≥ 6, apply Theorem 7.1 with derivative order J + 1, and then choose its corresponding k0 and initial parameters. There is a CJ graph S on an interior neighborhood of 0, with CJ norm at most Cm0, through 0 and tangent to P0 there, and a nonnegative Lipschitz function t on the fixed base, such that |HS| + |∇HS| ≤ Cm2 0t2k0−4 , |z| ≤ Cm0tk0 on spt µ. (7.18) In the first inequality t is evaluated at the horizontal coordinate of the point of S; in the second it may be evaluated either at π0X or at π0πSX, with a change of constant. Writing 60 I = {t > 0}, one has t(0) = 0, sup Br t = o(r), |I ∩ Br| = o(rm ). (7.19) In particular the support height is zero off the influence region. On S itself its normal-projection version has the same vanishing volume density. If ρ is distance to 0 on S, then |z| ≤ Cρ2 on the support in a sufficiently small tube.
